title: gemifi device YAML
description: gemifi: 2 device files (core/README.md "Device YAML"). Generated by tools/builder/gemifi_build.py schema: don't edit.

substitutions.description: name: value, used as ${name} in string values

packages.description: parts of a device file merged under this one: a file name, preset:<name>, !include or a mapping

min_version.description: the oldest gemifi builder that can build this file

gemifi.description: The format version of the file: 2.

name.description: The device's node name: lowercase letters, digits and -, at most 31 (`keystation-mini32`).

friendly_name.description: Its display name: the USB product string, HELLO and the web page. Default: name.

description.description: A line about it, for people reading the file.

version.description: The firmware version it reports (HELLO), major.minor.patch. Default: the build's.

board_id.description: The id a firmware image is checked against before it is flashed: a board profile's fixed one, or your own for a DIY board.

platform.description: The MCU family it builds for (the docs' Platforms).

board.description: The board profile (platform/<platform>/boards/<board>.json): its layout and board pins. Default: the platform's: m-audio-code61 (stm32f1), keystation-mini32-mk3 (nuvoton-nuc1xx).

daw_port.description: A second USB-MIDI port, `<friendly_name> DAW`, for Mackie Control: needs `mcu:` and USB MIDI. Default: true with mcu:.

anyOf.description: The USB ids, on platforms with native USB (ignored with another `midi.transport`). Default: the pid.codes test ids 1209:0002, for development only.

transport.description: How the device talks MIDI: `usb` (native USB, ESP32-S2/S3), `serial` (a UART) or `ble` (ESP32, ESP32-S3). Only the ESPs have a choice. Default: usb; serial on esp32.

id.description: What `i2c_id:` names. Required when `i2c:` is a list, optional on a single bus.

sda.description: The data pin (SDA), an MCU pin.

scl.description: The clock pin (SCL), an MCU pin.

anyOf.description: one I2C bus (its id optional), or a list of them, each with an id that I2C components name with i2c_id:

scan_interval.description: The scan tick's period: the key matrix (without `hardware_scan`), encoders on MCU pins and shift-register hubs are read every tick. Default: 125us.

row_time.description: The time per row: a frame is every row once (an odd row count gets its last row twice).

settle.description: From the row's select to the columns' read; at least 0.5us with `precharge`.

precharge.description: The columns are driven to their idle level before each row, so the read waits less: needs diodes or tolerant drivers. Default: false.

timer.description: The timer that paces the scan; `auto` takes the first that leaves the UARTs' DMA channels free. Default: auto.

matrix.description: The key matrix and every switch matrix, scanned row by row by a timer and DMA.

timer.description: The timer that steps the muxes and starts ADC1 (not TIM1). Default: auto.

analog.description: The analog inputs and pads, read in sweeps of mux steps and ADC conversions by a timer and DMA; `true`, or a mapping to pick the timer. Default: false.

anyOf.description: stm32f1: the matrices and the analog inputs scanned by timers and DMA instead of the CPU.

aftertouch.description: Polyphonic aftertouch while a pad is held. Per preset. Default: false. Can be changed on the device (pad.aftertouch).

threshold.description: The reading that starts a hit (readings are 0..4095). Between `release` and `full`. Default: 200. Can be changed on the device (pad.threshold).

release.description: Below this reading the pad is let go. Default: 100. Can be changed on the device (pad.release).

full.description: The peak reading that plays velocity 127. Default: 3000. Can be changed on the device (pad.full).

window.description: How long after the threshold a hit's peak is looked for. Default: 3ms. Can be changed on the device (pad.window).

retrigger.description: How long after a release the pad can't start a new hit (against bounce and double hits). Default: 20ms. Can be changed on the device (pad.retrigger).

tap_time.description: A second press within this long is a double tap (`button.tap_time`). Default: 200ms. Can be changed on the device (button.tap_time).

hold_time.description: Held this long, a press is a hold (`button.hold_time`). Default: 200ms. Can be changed on the device (button.hold_time).

combo_time.description: Buttons pressed within this long of the first are pressed together (`button.combo_time`). Default: 50ms. Can be changed on the device (button.combo_time).

repeat_delay.description: How long a button is held before it repeats (`button.repeat_delay`). Default: 500ms. Can be changed on the device (button.repeat_delay).

repeat_rate.description: The time between repeats (`button.repeat_rate`). Default: 50ms. Can be changed on the device (button.repeat_rate).

buttons.description: The buttons pressed together: 2 or more of the YAML's own, each once.

action.description: What it does: an action from the list, with its number key (`action:` or `actions:` is required).

actions.description: Messages sent in order at the press, instead of `action:`: each an action's name or a mapping. Can be changed on the device (button.action).

cc.description: The CC, with the actions `cc_momentary`, `cc_toggle` and `cc_ramp`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

note.description: The note, with action `note`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

preset.description: The preset slot (1..slots), with action `preset_select`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

program.description: The Program Change it sends, with action `program`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

mmc.description: The MMC command it sends, with action `mmc`: a name or 1..127. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

sysex.description: The id of the `midi_messages.sysex` string it sends, with action `sysex`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

tx_pin.description: The UART's TX pin: MIDI Out (stm32f1: PA9, USART1).

rx_pin.description: The UART's RX pin: MIDI In (stm32f1: PA10). Without it, MIDI Out only.

mode.description: How the jacks reach USB: on the device's own port (`usb_merge`), on a second USB-MIDI port (`separate_port`), or not at all (`din_only`). Default: usb_merge.

port_name.description: The second port's name, with `separate_port`; at most 31 characters. Default: <friendly_name> MIDI.

thru.description: DIN In is copied to DIN Out. Default: false. Can be changed on the device (midi.thru).

controller_out.description: The device's own messages (keys, pads, CCs, program changes) also go to DIN Out. Default: true. Can be changed on the device (midi.din_out).

usb_to_din.description: With `usb_merge`: the host's channel and realtime messages on the device's port go to DIN Out. Default: false. Can be changed on the device (midi.usb_to_din).

dma.description: stm32f1: the UART's bytes move by DMA (channels 4 and 5) instead of by interrupt. Default: false.

anyOf.description: 5-pin DIN MIDI In and Out on a UART, at 31250 baud (stm32f1 for now).

enable.description: Kinds to compile in even if no control uses them yet, for the web page (each kind is in anyway when one does). `rpn` is `nrpn`'s, `bank_select` `program`'s.

null_rpn.description: After each NRPN or RPN message, the null RPN (101 / 100 = 127). Default: false.

mmc_device_id.description: The device id MMC commands are sent to. Default: 0x7F (all devices).

data.description: Hex bytes F0 .. F7, with v, msb, lsb, ch and [ ... ] cs placeholders.
